text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-SD-3223/16-US32 16 Inch Modern Square Stainless Steel Shower Door Pulls

Very modern designed 16" glass shower door pulls made of 3/4" square solid stainless steel by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in door pulls. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sharp, crisp look is desired.

These modern square shower handles have a polished stainless steel finish.

Specifications for First Impressions SD-3223/16-US32 Modern Stainless Steel Shower Pulls

  • Total Length: 16"
  • Diameter: 3/4" Square
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Polished Stainless Steel

Note: These modern stainless steel shower door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 4 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
